tools.name: discover
tools.description: Describe this host and every plugin, including the setup prompt and the setup and validate commands.

tools.name: mesh.list
tools.description: List mesh tools, the repos that declared them, and the Cloudflare Access limits agents must stay inside.

tools.name: mesh.lsp
tools.description: Return the language servers declared for this repository.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check the catalog, mesh, repos, Cloudflare files, and GitHub workflows. Omit level for strict.

tools.name: mesh.skill
tools.description: Return one skill by name. The name is a skill id, not a path.

tools.name: events.webhooks
tools.description: Return the one event schema and each plugin webhook. Watch GET /events and filter with plugin, type, and name.

tools.name: events.workflow
tools.description: Record a ci or clean workflow event for one plugin. detail is started, ok, or error. The event stores no other text.
